t: Here, at 136 Gower Street, is a bust of Hippocrates, part of the building's architectural sculpture. It was made by the English sculptor William Aumonier, who lived from 1869 to 1943. Hippocrates was a Greek physician of the classical period, living around 460 to 370 BCE, and is known as the Father of Medicine. He is remembered for clinical observation, for prognosis, and for sorting diseases systematically. Those ideas shaped many modern specialties, including surgery and neurology.
